This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump notified Congress on May 1, 2026, that the Iran conflict is over and hostilities have terminated under war powers law, sidestepping a formal authorization vote amid a fragile ceasefire following Operation Epic Fury's dismantling of key Iranian military and nuclear assets in late March and early April. This follows a White House statement on April 8 confirming Iran's agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, though Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Tehran's latest peace proposal and received a CENTCOM briefing on April 30 for potential new military options. Ongoing diplomatic talks and congressional debates could influence whether a definitive public announcement of ending operations materializes before the market's resolution date, reflecting trader consensus on de-escalation signals versus lingering escalation risks.

title: LoL: Weibo Gaming vs Invictus Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Weibo Gaming and Invictus Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 1 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Weibo Gaming" if Weibo Gaming win the match against Invictus Gaming.

This market will resolve to "Invictus Gaming" if Invictus Gaming win the match against Weibo Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Weibo Gaming and Invictus Gaming each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 1.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Weibo Gaming enters this LPL Group Ascend BO3 rematch on momentum from a 2-0 upset over second-place Top Esports three days ago, boosting their 3-6 record amid a tough Split 2 where they've dropped six series. Invictus Gaming, at 3-5 with a five-match losing streak including a recent 0-2 defeat to Anyone's Legend, relies on jungle standout JiaQi and veteran support Meiko—acquired from WBG in the offseason—for stylistic edges in engage-heavy metas favoring Jarvan IV and Xin Zhao per patch 26.7 picks. WBG holds head-to-head advantage via their Week 3 2-1 win, headlined by midlaner Xiaohu's MVP performance, though no subs or injuries are reported; double round-robin positioning amplifies stakes for playoff contention.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran negotiations for a permanent peace deal remain stalled after marathon talks in Islamabad, Pakistan, ended April 12 without agreement, despite a fragile ceasefire holding since April 8 mediation by the same host. President Trump dismissed Iran's latest proposal—submitted via Pakistan hours ago to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and potentially delay nuclear curbs—as "not satisfactory," signaling persistent gaps over sanctions relief, ballistic missiles, and Tehran's nuclear program. Trader consensus reflects low near-term odds amid mutual recriminations and US naval actions like tanker seizures, though a second round could emerge if deadlines flex; Gulf and European officials estimate months for any comprehensive accord.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil futures for May 2026 trade near $105 per barrel, propelled by acute supply disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz amid escalating Iran tensions, which have idled 9.1 million barrels per day and triggered record U.S. inventory draws of 6.2 million barrels to 459.5 million—1% above the five-year average. OPEC+ approved a modest 206,000 bpd quota hike for May while pausing further increases, counterbalanced by the UAE's exit from the alliance effective today, adding uncertainty to production dynamics. Backwardation in the futures curve reflects trader consensus on near-term tightness, though Goldman Sachs sees average 2026 prices cooling to $78 amid normalization risks. Key catalysts include weekly EIA reports and Hormuz developments.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 24 - May 1, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 24 12:00 PM ET to May 1, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:
This market will resolve to the country whose candidate for Eurovision 2026 wins.

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If no winner is announced by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve "Other". All ties will be broken according to EBU's official Eurovision rules.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland leads Polymarket's Eurovision 2026 trader consensus at a 34.4% implied probability, driven by the violin-pop duo Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen's "Liekinheitin," which crushed Finland's UMK national final in February and dominates fan polls, bookmakers, and mock jury votes for its orchestral drama and broad jury-televote appeal. Greece's Akylas follows at 17.3% with edgy "Ferto," a Sing for Greece winner gaining from strong pre-party buzz and Balkan voting potential, while Denmark's Søren Torpegaard (12.7%) and France's entry (8.0%) vie with melodic hooks and internal selection momentum. First rehearsals began May 1 in Vienna, where staging and live vocals could ignite shifts in this uncertain field before semis on May 12-14.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket favors California Governor Gavin Newsom as the 2028 Democratic presidential nominee frontrunner at 26% implied probability, reflecting his executive experience, national fundraising strength, and term limit freeing him after January 2027 amid a fragmented primary field. Kamala Harris trails at 11% despite a recent polling surge to 29% in McLaughlin's April survey following her April 10 National Action Network remarks signaling interest in another White House bid, with traders discounting her 2024 loss baggage. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez at 9% draws progressive support, while Jon Ossoff and others like Pete Buttigieg and Josh Shapiro hover lower on Senate visibility and swing-state appeal. Key differentiators include gubernatorial records, ideological breadth, and electability in battlegrounds; 2026 midterm outcomes, early fundraising, and party endorsements could consolidate support.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Polymarket traders overwhelmingly price a 95.5% implied probability of no change at the June FOMC meeting, holding the federal funds rate steady in its current 3.50%-3.75% target range, driven by the Federal Reserve's April 28-29 decision to maintain policy amid stubbornly elevated inflation—highlighted by March CPI at 3.3% year-over-year, the highest since 2024—and a resilient labor market with low but steady job gains and stable unemployment around 4.1%. This skin-in-the-game consensus reflects trader confidence in the Fed's wait-and-see stance amid economic uncertainty, including policy dissent noted in recent minutes. Realistic challenges include softer-than-expected May nonfarm payrolls or a sharp April CPI drop below 3%, potentially tilting odds toward a 25 basis point cut, with the June 11-12 meeting approaching rapidly.

title: LoL: Top Esports vs Anyone's Legend (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Top Esports and Anyone's Legend in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 1 at 5:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Top Esports" if Top Esports win the match against Anyone's Legend.

This market will resolve to "Anyone's Legend" if Anyone's Legend win the match against Top Esports.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Top Esports and Anyone's Legend each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 1.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket positions Robert F. Kennedy Jr. at 49% implied probability for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, driven by his high-profile role as HHS Secretary, the growing MAHA movement's appeal to the GOP base, and his April 4 launch of a midterm travel push to bolster Republican candidates amid policy fights on health and food safety. Vice President J.D. Vance holds 38.6% as the polls-leading heir apparent with incumbency advantages, though recent surveys like the April 19 YouGov poll underscore a tight field. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 20.6% reflects buzz from his foreign policy handling, including March developments on Iran, fueling a "Draft Rubio" push among donors despite Vance's edge. Midterm results and 2026-2027 positioning will likely sway early odds.

eventMetadata.context_description: Lakers hold a 3-2 series lead over the Rockets in their Western Conference first-round playoff matchup, with Game 6 tonight at Toyota Center in Houston setting up a potential closeout or do-or-die Game 7. Rockets seized momentum by winning the last two games, including a 99-93 road victory in Game 5 behind Alperen Sengun's double-double and aggressive full-court pressure that exploited Lakers' turnover woes (17.8 per 100 plays). Lakers star Luka Doncic remains out with a hamstring strain, while Austin Reaves returned from a four-week oblique absence but shot inefficiently in 34 minutes during Game 5 amid fatigue; Rockets' Kevin Durant is sidelined for a fourth straight game with an ankle sprain. Houston's youthful core—featuring Reed Sheppard, Jabari Smith Jr., and Amen Thompson—has won key 50/50 battles at home, challenging LeBron James' triple-double threat averaging 22.2 PPG, 7.2 RPG, and 8.4 APG.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects tight competition among mid-range outcomes for Elon Musk's X posts from April 28 to May 5, with 160-179 tweets leading at 23.3% implied probability, closely trailed by 140-159 (19.4%) and 180-199 (16.3%), signaling uncertainty over his posting surge potential. Driving this positioning, XTracker data shows 51 posts logged through 57% of the period as of May 1 afternoon, averaging about 12 daily—below Elon's historical 20-30 peak amid viral controversies—but traders anticipate acceleration from fresh catalysts like his OpenAI trial testimony fallout on April 29 and potential commentary on cultural flashpoints such as politics or tech policy. Remaining days through May 5 hold sway, as breaking news could ignite his signature high-engagement tweet storms, differentiating frontrunners in this pop culture staple of social media spectacle.

eventMetadata.context_description: G2 holds the edge as the higher-ranked (#12 HLTV) squad in this BLAST Rivals Fort Worth playoffs quarterfinal BO3 against underdog FaZe (#28), having advanced via a dominant 2-0 group stage rout of Astralis two days ago after an earlier setback to Vitality. FaZe clawed into playoffs 21 hours ago with a 2-1 humiliation of FURIA in the Group B decider, rebounding from inconsistent form amid a recent roster overhaul—dropping karrigan and integrating Twistzz on just six days' practice. G2 leads recent head-to-head (2-0 win in March ESL Pro League), excelling on key maps like Ancient (79% winrate). Map vetoes, current meta favoring structured play, and FaZe's adaptation risks shape trader consensus toward G2's momentum.

eventMetadata.context_description: In Game 6 of the Eastern Conference first-round playoffs, the No. 8 Orlando Magic hold a 3-2 series lead over the No. 1 Detroit Pistons and host a potential closeout at Kia Center, with Game 7 looming Sunday if necessary. Magic forward Franz Wagner remains out with a right calf strain for the second straight game, depriving them of his 16.8 points per game average through four contests, while Jonathan Isaac continues sidelined by knee issues. Pistons' Tobias Harris is questionable with a left ankle sprain after scoring 23 in their 116-109 Game 5 road win, where Cade Cunningham's 45 points edged Paolo Banchero's 45 amid strong rebounding from Ausar Thompson. Detroit's top regular-season mark (60-22) fuels comeback hopes, but Orlando's home-court edge and defensive grit have driven the upset bid.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by May 15?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 15, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains severely restricted at about 5% of normal levels, with only 5-6 vessels transiting daily as of May 1 versus the pre-crisis average of 125-140, anchoring trader consensus at 94.5% against a return to normal by May 15 per IMF Portwatch criteria. This reflects the ongoing dual blockade—Iran's IRGC-imposed tolls and selective permissions alongside the US naval blockade of Iranian ports—following the April 8 ceasefire breakdown amid stalled Pakistan-mediated talks. Pentagon officials estimated on April 21 that clearing Iranian mines could take six months, while recent US Treasury advisories against toll payments and persistent war-risk insurance spikes deter full resumption. A US invitation to allies like New Zealand signals potential de-escalation efforts, but no breakthroughs have materialized in the past week.

title: Which company has the best AI model end of May?
description:
This market will resolve according to the company that owns the model that has the highest arena rank based on the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard (https://lmarena.ai/) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on May 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard/text with style control off will be used to resolve this market.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “xAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking system.

The resolution source for this market is the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard found at https://lmarena.ai/. If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve based on another resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7, released April 16, 2026, has propelled the company to a commanding 79.5% implied probability of holding the top AI model spot by month's end, dominating Arena.ai (formerly LMSYS Chatbot Arena) leaderboards with top-four positions across key benchmarks like reasoning, coding, and long-context tasks. Traders' strong consensus reflects its superior Elo ratings and consistent outperformance over rivals, bolstered by Anthropic's rapid iteration cadence—shipping major updates biweekly—amid a competitive landscape where Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro (16.5%) trails despite strong reasoning scores from its February launch. OpenAI's GPT-5.4 lags further at 3.3% due to higher hallucination risks, while xAI and others hover below 2%. With resolution imminent, watch for surprise model drops or benchmark shifts from Google DeepMind or OpenAI agents.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump's nominee Kevin Warsh advanced through the Senate Banking Committee on a 13-11 party-line vote April 29, clearing a key hurdle for full Senate confirmation before Jerome Powell's Fed chair term expires May 15. Trump selected Warsh in January amid policy critiques of Powell, who plans to remain on the Federal Reserve Board of Governors. Warsh's April confirmation hearing addressed Democratic concerns over Fed independence from Sen. Elizabeth Warren, yet garnered bipartisan signals like Sen. John Fetterman's support. Traders' 99.5% consensus on Warsh reflects Republican Senate majority and procedural momentum, though senatorial holds, procedural delays, scandals, or health issues could still disrupt the path.

title: Brazil Presidential Election
description:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent congressional override of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's veto has slashed former President Jair Bolsonaro's 27-year coup sentence, potentially by up to 20 years, energizing right-wing voters and elevating his son Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's profile ahead of the October 4 first-round vote. Late April polls, including AtlasIntel (April 22-27) showing a 46.6%-39.7% Lula-Flávio first-round split and statistical runoff tie at 47.5%-47.8%, underscore the closely contested race reflected in trader consensus favoring Flávio slightly. Polarized electorate with solid PT and PL bases keeps it tight, but Supreme Court challenges to the bill, economic data, party conventions, and endorsements could tip probabilities toward a decisive runoff on October 25.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Jordan Bardella and Édouard Philippe top trader consensus at 22.5% and 21.5% implied probabilities for the 2027 French presidential election, mirroring recent polls where Bardella leads first-round voting intentions at 34-38% amid widespread desire for change, while Philippe surges to 18-25% and narrowly prevails in runoffs (e.g., 51.5-48.5% in Elabe's late March survey). March municipal elections curbed Rassemblement National gains in major cities like Paris, boosting center-right Philippe's appeal as the strongest barrage against far-right advance in a fragmented field lacking resolved primaries. Left-wing Jean-Luc Mélenchon trails at 8.5%, with Marine Le Pen fading. Separation could arise from party nominations, economic shifts, or scandals ahead of the April 2027 first round.
